name: Hazuki Kaoru
source:
A junior at the private girls' school, Seishin High. Friends with Ami, the protagonist's sister. She loves researching ghosts and the occult. In spite of the more reserved air around her, she's quite strange; she's bold and fears nothing. She strongly favors gothic lolita clothing.

[From [url=http://www.aksysgames.com/ng/characters/]Aksys Games[/url]]
